data.define: Describes jokes that are so silly they're embarrassing.

misuse.text: Don't call your teacher's joke 'corny' out loud.

publish.title: What does "corny" mean?
publish.value: Corny = Old-fashioned and silly. Example: "Dad's jokes are so corny." (casual English, US).
